tools.name: get_go_annotations
tools.description: Retrieve GO annotations for a UniProt gene product from QuickGO (complete, count-verified).

tools.name: get_kegg_entries
tools.description: Fetch KEGG entries by ID (genes, pathways, compounds, ...) — batched /get, 10 per request.

tools.name: get_ontology_term
tools.description: Fetch one ontology term's details, or its complete related-term set.

tools.name: get_uniprot_entries
tools.description: Fetch UniProtKB records for a list of accessions (batched OR-queries, not per-accession).

tools.name: link_kegg_ids
tools.description: Cross-reference KEGG IDs against another database (/link) or convert to/from outside IDs (/conv).

tools.name: list_ontologies
tools.description: List ontologies in the EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS4).

tools.name: map_reactome_pathways
tools.description: Map gene symbols or UniProt accessions to Reactome pathways (AnalysisService token workflow).

tools.name: query_genes
tools.description: Resolve gene identifiers/symbols via mygene.info (batched, up to 1000 terms/request).

tools.name: search_kegg
tools.description: Search a KEGG database by keyword (/find), with optional exact gene-symbol resolution.

tools.name: search_ontology_terms
tools.description: Search ontology terms by label/synonym across one or more OLS4 ontologies.
